policies.title: Papua New Guinean ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Papua New Guinea as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Papua New Guinean passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Papua New Guinean ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Papua New Guinea in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Papua New Guinean passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
